coding.label: Coding
notes: BMI codes (G8417/G8418/G8420, 3008F, Z68) on ANY visit with a documented BMI — not only preventive visits; 4 times per calendar year each
Adult BMI: G8418 up to 18.5, G8420 up to 24.99, G8417 from 25; ICD Z68.18 / Z68.19 below 20
Children: Z68.55 for 120% of the 95th percentile
Pain (1125F / 1126F) decided by ICD code only
Alcohol: G0442 (or 3016F when G0442 can't be billed), G9622 if negative, no positive code
Depression: G0444 (or 3725F when G0444 can't be billed)
